attrs.evidence: GPT-5.6's best addition, and neither Mosaic proposal had made the join object first class: without it, Objective, Contract, Evidence, Operation and Lineage records can each be individually valid while referring to different versions. Implemented for one transition — mosaic/receipts/INV-R5.json binds R4.1 to R5 — and the gate verifies the head receipt's digests against the files they name. ONE CORRECTION TO GPT'S FRAMING, and it is the C10 incident at factory scale: a receipt WRITTEN AFTER the gate ran is a log, not a gate, and two representations of one decision drift. The receipt's `decision` field must be the output of the same predicate the promotion consults, or the pair is exactly `feasible` disagreeing with `charge`. This round does not close that: R5's receipt is written after its gates ran, and says so in its own `honesty` field.
attrs.prior_art: in-toto link metadata (authorized functionary, command, materials, products, verified against a layout) is the shape. Tan, Singer & Anagnostopoulos, 'Attesting LLM Pipelines: Enforcing Verifiable Training and Release Claims' (LLMSC 2026 workshop, arXiv 2603.28988) proposes an attestation-aware PROMOTION GATE with allow/quarantine/block over claim bundles — the closest published relative, and a workshop position paper rather than a mature standard. SLSA v1.2 (approved 24 Nov 2025) supplies Build and Source track attestations and states the separation this record depends on: it records evidence, and policy decides what is acceptable.
attrs.review_focus: The receipt is descriptive this round, not decisive. Attack the gap between 'the receipt records what the gates decided' and 'the gate decides by reading the receipt' — the second is the version that cannot drift, and it is not built.
attrs.statement: Every attempted promotion emits one immutable receipt binding the exact predecessor state, candidate, operation, contract set, invariant delta, objective portfolio, evidence set, evaluator versions, authority and decision. A promotion whose references do not resolve to one coherent versioned state is invalid.
